name: Rubic Hearts
source:
Winter of second year in high school. Study is hard, but there are also happy moments. As things start to take unexpected turn, he has an opportunity to get a girlfriend. Will he choose among classmates or sempai? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
高中二年级的冬天。学习虽然辛苦，却也不乏快乐的时光。当事情开始出现意想不到的转折时，他迎来了交到女朋友的机会。他会在同班同学与学姐之间选择谁呢？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
